anchor.exact: there exist in Ainu poetry more than one pattern among the types of meter found in languages of the world and they are used differentially by one and the same reciter

statement.en: Multiple patterns among cross-linguistic types of meter exist in Ainu poetry and are used differentially by one and the same reciter.
statement.ja: アイヌ語の詩には世界の諸言語に見られる韻律の類型のうち複数のパターンが存在し、同一の語り手によって使い分けられている。

entailment.quote: there exist in Ainu poetry more than one pattern among the types of meter found in languages of the world and they are used differentially by one and the same reciter.

anchor.exact: there are said to be dialects of Ainu that do not have a distinction in accent.

entailment.quote: there are said to be dialects of Ainu that do not have a distinction in accent.

anchor.exact: Even though they are separated geographically, the Saru and Chitose dialects are known to have non-metrical characteristics in common.

entailment.quote: the Saru and Chitose dialects are known to have non-metrical characteristics in common.

anchor.exact: one possible hypothesis would be that the “accent orientation” is a metrical technique original within Ainu, while the “syllable count orientation” was picked up through contact with the meter of Japanese.

statement.en: Accent orientation may have been a metrical technique original to Ainu, whereas syllable count orientation was acquired through contact with the meter of Japanese.
statement.ja: アクセント志向韻律はアイヌ語内部に本来的な韻律技法であり、音節数志向韻律は日本語の韻律との接触を通じて獲得された可能性がある。

entailment.quote: one possible hypothesis would be that the 'accent orientation' is a metrical technique original within Ainu, while the 'syllable count orientation' was picked up through contact with the meter of Japanese.

statement.ja: 千歳地方の神謡においても、沙流地方の伝承者に見られるのと同様の「アクセント志向」の韻律が観察される。

entailment.quote: the same 'accent orientation' meter found in the performers from the Saru region could also be observed in these poems.

statement.ja: 千歳の神謡『Wawo kamuy』において、4音節行62行中56行、およびすべての2音節行・3音節行で行頭の第1音節にアクセントが置かれている。

anchor.exact: In addition to the “syllable count orientation” meter that has long been pointed out, Ainu oral literature also has as a technique of composition an “accent orientation” meter that shows a spread geographically.

statement.en: In addition to syllable-count-oriented meter, Ainu oral literature employs an accent-oriented meter as a composition technique that shows geographical spread.
statement.ja: アイヌ口承文芸には、従来指摘されてきた音節数志向の韻律に加えて、地理的な広がりをもつ作詩技法としての「アクセント志向」の韻律が存在する。

entailment.quote: In addition to the “syllable count orientation” meter that has long been pointed out, Ainu oral literature also has as a technique of composition an “accent orientation” meter that shows a spread geographically.

anchor.exact: there also exists in the tradition of Ainu verse, a metric that arranges the placement of accent within a line, termed “accent orientation”

statement.en: In the tradition of Ainu verse, there exists a metric that arranges the placement of pitch accent within a line, termed 'accent orientation'.
statement.ja: アイヌ語の韻文の伝統には、行内のアクセントの配置を整える「アクセント志向」と呼ばれる韻律が存在する。

entailment.quote: the present author has in recent years pointed out that the fact that there also exists in the tradition of Ainu verse, a metric that arranges the placement of accent within a line, termed 'accent orientation'

anchor.exact: insertion of auxiliary verb ki ‘do’ between verbs, auxiliaries, and final particles

statement.en: The auxiliary verb ki 'do' can be inserted between verbs, auxiliaries, and final particles as a versification technique to adjust syllable count and rhythm.
statement.ja: 音節数やリズムを調整する作歌技法として、動詞・助動詞・終助詞の間に補助動詞 ki「する」が挿入されることがある。

entailment.quote: insertion of auxiliary verb ki ‘do’ between verbs, auxiliaries, and final particles

anchor.exact: use of uncontracted form of person marker ku-

statement.ja: 詩行の音節数を調整する技法として、人称標識 ku- の非縮約形が用いられる。

entailment.quote: use of uncontracted form of person marker ku-

entailment.quote: addition of /u/ at the beginning of lines when reciting

anchor.exact: In the Hokkaidō dialects of Ainu, there are five vowels and 12 consonants, including the glottal stop, that can appear as the onset of a syllable, and nine consonants that can appear in the coda position.

statement.en: In Hokkaido Ainu dialects, there are five vowels, twelve consonants (including the glottal stop) that can occur as syllable onsets, and nine consonants that can appear in coda position.
statement.ja: 北海道アイヌ語諸方言において、母音は5個、音節頭子音として生起しうる子音は声門閉鎖音を含めて12個、音節末子音として生起しうる子音は9個である。

entailment.quote: In the Hokkaidō dialects of Ainu, there are five vowels and 12 consonants, including the glottal stop, that can appear as the onset of a syllable, and nine consonants that can appear in the coda position.

anchor.exact: in word formation in Ainu, a single root may be reduplicated and reduplication of a vowel is common in word derivation
